title: Multiple nodules in the oral cavity
html: A 42-year-old Hispanic woman sought treatment for several widely distributed soft-tissue nodules involving the tongue and buccal mucosa. She first noticed the lesions approximately 5 months previously. She reported transient discomfort on the left side of the tongue 3 months earlier but was otherwise asymptomatic. Her medical history was unremarkable; she was healthy, was not taking any medications, and denied tobacco use.
